summary: Raised the periodic report DeepSeek timeout from 180 to 300 seconds after two cloud runs failed at the timeout boundary while the exact local request completed in 80 seconds; added failed child diagnostics to controller output.
checks: Exact local weekly generation succeeded with 219 signals and 33 opinions and 186 community items
issues: Cloud weekly generation failed twice after about 190 seconds with content_generation_failed.
risks: The workflow can now wait up to five minutes for the report model while remaining inside its 45-minute job limit.
lessons: Cloud model latency can exceed local latency and failures must retain child stderr.
reusable_rules: Use a five-minute report-generation timeout and print failed action diagnostics.
